verses.original: Καὶ ὁ Ἰησοῦς ἐξελθὼν ἀπὸ τοῦ ἱεροῦ ἐπορεύετο καὶ αὐτοῦ οἱ μαθηταὶ προσῆλθον ἐπιδεῖξαι αὐτῷ τοῦ ἱεροῦ τὰς οἰκοδομὰς
verses.transliteration: Kai ho Iēsous exelthōn apo tou hierou eporeueto kai autou hoi mathētai prosēlthon epideixai autō tou hierou tas oikodomas
verses.literal: [As] - Jesus left . . . the temple [and] was walking away - His - disciples came up to [Him] to point out - - [its] - buildings

verses.original: Οὐ βλέπετε πάντα ταῦτα δὲ ὁ ἀποκριθεὶς εἶπεν αὐτοῖς ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν οὐ μὴ λίθος ὧδε ἀφεθῇ ἐπὶ λίθον ὃς οὐ καταλυθήσεται
verses.transliteration: Ou blepete panta tauta de ho apokritheis eipen autois amēn legō hymin ou mē lithos hōde aphethē epi lithon hos ou katalythēsetai
verses.literal: vvv Do you see all these things vvv vvv vvv He replied . . . Truly I tell you vvv not one stone here will be left on [another] [every one] . . . will be thrown down

verses.original: δὲ αὐτοῦ Καθημένου ἐπὶ τοῦ ὄρους τῶν Ἐλαιῶν οἱ μαθηταὶ προσῆλθον αὐτῷ κατ’ ἰδίαν Εἰπὲ ἡμῖν λέγοντες πότε ταῦτα ἔσται καὶ τί τὸ σημεῖον σῆς τῆς παρουσίας καὶ συντελείας τοῦ αἰῶνος
verses.transliteration: de autou Kathēmenou epi tou orous tōn Elaiōn hoi mathētai prosēlthon autō kat’ idian Eipe hēmin legontes pote tauta estai kai ti to sēmeion sēs tēs parousias kai synteleias tou aiōnos
verses.literal: [While] [Jesus] was sitting on the Mount - of Olives the disciples came to Him vvv privately Tell us they said when {will} these things happen and what [will be] the sign of Your - coming and of the end of the age

verses.original: Καὶ ὁ Ἰησοῦς ἀποκριθεὶς εἶπεν αὐτοῖς Βλέπετε μή τις πλανήσῃ ὑμᾶς
verses.transliteration: Kai ho Iēsous apokritheis eipen autois Blepete mē tis planēsē hymas
verses.literal: - - Jesus answered . . . . . . See to it that no one . . . deceives you

verses.original: γὰρ πολλοὶ ἐλεύσονται ἐπὶ μου τῷ ὀνόματί λέγοντες Ἐγώ εἰμι ὁ Χριστός καὶ πλανήσουσιν πολλοὺς
verses.transliteration: gar polloi eleusontai epi mou tō onomati legontes Egō eimi ho Christos kai planēsousin pollous
verses.literal: For many will come in My - name claiming I am the Christ and will deceive many . . .

verses.original: δὲ μελλήσετε ἀκούειν πολέμους καὶ ἀκοὰς πολέμων ὁρᾶτε μὴ θροεῖσθε γὰρ δεῖ γενέσθαι ἀλλ’ τὸ τέλος ἐστὶν οὔπω
verses.transliteration: de mellēsete akouein polemous kai akoas polemōn horate mē throeisthe gar dei genesthai all’ to telos estin oupō
verses.literal: - You will hear of wars and rumors of wars but see to it vvv that you are not alarmed [These things] must happen but the end is still to come

verses.original: γὰρ ἔθνος ἐγερθήσεται ἐπὶ ἔθνος καὶ βασιλεία ἐπὶ βασιλείαν καὶ ἔσονται λιμοὶ καὶ σεισμοὶ κατὰ τόπους
verses.transliteration: gar ethnos egerthēsetai epi ethnos kai basileia epi basileian kai esontai limoi kai seismoi kata topous
verses.literal: - Nation will rise against nation and kingdom against kingdom - There will be famines and earthquakes in [various] places

verses.original: δὲ πάντα ταῦτα ἀρχὴ ὠδίνων
verses.transliteration: de panta tauta archē ōdinōn
verses.literal: - All these [are] [the] beginning of birth pains

verses.original: Τότε παραδώσουσιν ὑμᾶς εἰς θλῖψιν καὶ ἀποκτενοῦσιν ὑμᾶς καὶ ἔσεσθε μισούμενοι ὑπὸ πάντων τῶν ἐθνῶν διὰ μου τὸ ὄνομά
verses.transliteration: Tote paradōsousin hymas eis thlipsin kai apoktenousin hymas kai esesthe misoumenoi hypo pantōn tōn ethnōn dia mou to onoma
verses.literal: Then they will deliver you over to be persecuted and killed . . . and you will be hated by all - nations because of My - name

verses.original: καὶ τότε πολλοὶ σκανδαλισθήσονται καὶ παραδώσουσιν ἀλλήλους καὶ μισήσουσιν ἀλλήλους
verses.transliteration: kai tote polloi skandalisthēsontai kai paradōsousin allēlous kai misēsousin allēlous
verses.literal: - At that time many will fall away and will betray - and hate one another

verses.original: καὶ πολλοὶ ψευδοπροφῆται ἐγερθήσονται καὶ πλανήσουσιν πολλούς
verses.transliteration: kai polloi pseudoprophētai egerthēsontai kai planēsousin pollous
verses.literal: and many false prophets will arise and deceive many

verses.original: Καὶ διὰ τὸ πληθυνθῆναι τὴν ἀνομίαν ἡ ἀγάπη τῶν πολλῶν ψυγήσεται
verses.transliteration: Kai dia to plēthynthēnai tēn anomian hē agapē tōn pollōn psygēsetai
verses.literal: - Because of - the multiplication - of wickedness the love of most will grow cold

verses.original: δὲ ὁ ὑπομείνας εἰς τέλος οὗτος σωθήσεται
verses.transliteration: de ho hypomeinas eis telos houtos sōthēsetai
verses.literal: But the [one who] perseveres to [the] end - will be saved

verses.original: Καὶ τοῦτο τὸ εὐαγγέλιον τῆς βασιλείας κηρυχθήσεται ἐν ὅλῃ τῇ οἰκουμένῃ εἰς μαρτύριον πᾶσιν τοῖς ἔθνεσιν καὶ τότε τὸ τέλος ἥξει
verses.transliteration: Kai touto to euangelion tēs basileias kērychthēsetai en holē tē oikoumenē eis martyrion pasin tois ethnesin kai tote to telos hēxei
verses.literal: And this - gospel of the kingdom will be preached in all the world as a testimony to all - nations and then the end will come

verses.original: οὖν Ὅταν ἴδητε ἑστὸς ἐν ἁγίῳ τόπῳ Τὸ βδέλυγμα τῆς ἐρημώσεως τὸ ῥηθὲν διὰ τοῦ προφήτου Δανιὴλ ὁ ἀναγινώσκων νοείτω
verses.transliteration: oun Hotan idēte hestos en hagiō topō To bdelygma tēs erēmōseōs to rhēthen dia tou prophētou Daniēl ho anaginōskōn noeitō
verses.literal: So when you see standing in [the] holy place the abomination - of desolation - spoken of by the prophet Daniel ({let} the reader understand)

verses.original: τότε οἱ ἐν τῇ Ἰουδαίᾳ φευγέτωσαν εἰς τὰ ὄρη
verses.transliteration: tote hoi en tē Ioudaia pheugetōsan eis ta orē
verses.literal: then {let} those who are in - Judea flee to the mountains

verses.original: ὁ ἐπὶ τοῦ δώματος μὴ καταβάτω ἆραι τὰ ἐκ αὐτοῦ τῆς οἰκίας
verses.transliteration: ho epi tou dōmatos mē katabatō arai ta ek autou tēs oikias
verses.literal: [Let no one] on the housetop - come down to retrieve anything from his - house

verses.original: καὶ ὁ ἐν τῷ ἀγρῷ μὴ ἐπιστρεψάτω ὀπίσω ἆραι αὐτοῦ τὸ ἱμάτιον
verses.transliteration: kai ho en tō agrō mē epistrepsatō opisō arai autou to himation
verses.literal: And [let no one] in the field - return . . . for his - cloak

verses.original: δὲ Οὐαὶ ἐν ἐκείναις ταῖς ἡμέραις ταῖς ἐχούσαις ἐν γαστρὶ καὶ ταῖς θηλαζούσαις
verses.transliteration: de Ouai en ekeinais tais hēmerais tais echousais en gastri kai tais thēlazousais
verses.literal: How miserable - those - days [will be] for pregnant . . . . . . and - nursing [mothers]

verses.original: δὲ προσεύχεσθε ἵνα ὑμῶν ἡ φυγὴ μὴ γένηται χειμῶνος μηδὲ σαββάτῳ
verses.transliteration: de proseuchesthe hina hymōn hē phygē mē genētai cheimōnos mēde sabbatō
verses.literal: - Pray that your - flight vvv will not occur in the winter [or] on the Sabbath

verses.original: γὰρ τότε ἔσται μεγάλη θλῖψις οἵα οὐ γέγονεν ἀπ’ ἀρχῆς κόσμου ἕως τοῦ νῦν οὐδ’ μὴ οὐ γένηται
verses.transliteration: gar tote estai megalē thlipsis hoia ou gegonen ap’ archēs kosmou heōs tou nyn oud’ mē ou genētai
verses.literal: For at that time there will be great tribulation unseen . . . . . . from [the] beginning of [the] world until - now [and] vvv never to be [seen again]

verses.original: καὶ εἰ μὴ ἐκεῖναι αἱ ἡμέραι ἐκολοβώθησαν οὐκ πᾶσα σάρξ ἂν ἐσώθη δὲ διὰ τοὺς ἐκλεκτοὺς ἐκεῖναι αἱ ἡμέραι κολοβωθήσονται
verses.transliteration: kai ei mē ekeinai hai hēmerai ekolobōthēsan ouk pasa sarx an esōthē de dia tous eklektous ekeinai hai hēmerai kolobōthēsontai
verses.literal: - If . . . those - days had not been cut short . . . nobody . . . vvv would be saved But for the sake of the elect those - days will be cut short

verses.original: Τότε ἐάν τις εἴπῃ ὑμῖν Ἰδοὺ ὧδε ὁ Χριστός ἤ Ὧδε μὴ πιστεύσητε
verses.transliteration: Tote ean tis eipē hymin Idou hōde ho Christos ē Hōde mē pisteusēte
verses.literal: At that time if anyone says to you Look here [is] the Christ or There [He is] {do} not believe [it]

verses.original: γὰρ ψευδόχριστοι καὶ ψευδοπροφῆται ἐγερθήσονται καὶ δώσουσιν μεγάλα σημεῖα καὶ τέρατα ὥστε πλανῆσαι καὶ τοὺς ἐκλεκτούς εἰ δυνατὸν
verses.transliteration: gar pseudochristoi kai pseudoprophētai egerthēsontai kai dōsousin megala sēmeia kai terata hōste planēsai kai tous eklektous ei dynaton
verses.literal: For false Christs and false prophets will appear and perform great signs and wonders to deceive even the elect if that were possible

verses.original: ἰδοὺ προείρηκα ὑμῖν
verses.transliteration: idou proeirēka hymin
verses.literal: See I have told you in advance . . .

verses.original: οὖν Ἐὰν εἴπωσιν ὑμῖν Ἰδοὺ ἐστίν ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ μὴ ἐξέλθητε Ἰδοὺ ἐν τοῖς ταμείοις μὴ πιστεύσητε
verses.transliteration: oun Ean eipōsin hymin Idou estin en tē erēmō mē exelthēte Idou en tois tameiois mē pisteusēte
verses.literal: So if they tell you There He is in the wilderness {do} not go out [or], ‘Here [He is,] in the inner rooms {do} not believe [it]

verses.original: γὰρ ὥσπερ ἡ ἀστραπὴ ἐξέρχεται ἀπὸ ἀνατολῶν καὶ φαίνεται ἕως δυσμῶν οὕτως ἔσται ἡ παρουσία τοῦ Υἱοῦ τοῦ ἀνθρώπου
verses.transliteration: gar hōsper hē astrapē exerchetai apo anatolōn kai phainetai heōs dysmōn houtōs estai hē parousia tou Huiou tou anthrōpou
verses.literal: For just as the lightning comes from [the] east and flashes as far as [the] west so will be the coming of the Son - of Man

verses.original: ὅπου ἐὰν ᾖ τὸ πτῶμα ἐκεῖ οἱ ἀετοί συναχθήσονται
verses.transliteration: hopou ean ē to ptōma ekei hoi aetoi synachthēsontai
verses.literal: Wherever . . . there is - a carcass there the vultures will gather

verses.original: δὲ Εὐθέως μετὰ τὴν θλῖψιν ἐκείνων τῶν ἡμερῶν Ὁ ἥλιος σκοτισθήσεται Καὶ ἡ σελήνη οὐ δώσει αὐτῆς τὸ φέγγος Καὶ οἱ ἀστέρες πεσοῦνται ἀπὸ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ Καὶ αἱ δυνάμεις τῶν οὐρανῶν σαλευθήσονται
verses.transliteration: de Eutheōs meta tēn thlipsin ekeinōn tōn hēmerōn Ho hēlios skotisthēsetai Kai hē selēnē ou dōsei autēs to phengos Kai hoi asteres pesountai apo tou ouranou Kai hai dynameis tōn ouranōn saleuthēsontai
verses.literal: - Immediately after the tribulation of those - days The sun will be darkened and the moon vvv will not give its - light - the stars will fall from the sky and the powers of the heavens will be shaken

verses.original: Καὶ τότε τὸ σημεῖον τοῦ Υἱοῦ τοῦ ἀνθρώπου φανήσεται ἐν τῷ οὐρανῷ καὶ τότε πᾶσαι αἱ φυλαὶ τῆς γῆς κόψονται καὶ ὄψονται τὸν Υἱὸν τοῦ ἀνθρώπου ἐρχόμενον ἐπὶ τῶν νεφελῶν τοῦ οὐρανοῦ μετὰ δυνάμεως καὶ πολλῆς δόξης
verses.transliteration: Kai tote to sēmeion tou Huiou tou anthrōpou phanēsetai en tō ouranō kai tote pasai hai phylai tēs gēs kopsontai kai opsontai ton Huion tou anthrōpou erchomenon epi tōn nephelōn tou ouranou meta dynameōs kai pollēs doxēs
verses.literal: vvv At that time the sign of the Son - of Man will appear in - heaven and . . . all the tribes of the earth will mourn - They will see the Son - of Man coming on the clouds - of heaven with power and great glory

verses.original: καὶ ἀποστελεῖ αὐτοῦ τοὺς ἀγγέλους μετὰ μεγάλης σάλπιγγος καὶ ἐπισυνάξουσιν αὐτοῦ τοὺς ἐκλεκτοὺς ἐκ τῶν τεσσάρων ἀνέμων ἀπ’ ἄκρων οὐρανῶν ἕως αὐτῶν τῶν ἄκρων
verses.transliteration: kai apostelei autou tous angelous meta megalēs salpingos kai episynaxousin autou tous eklektous ek tōn tessarōn anemōn ap’ akrōn ouranōn heōs autōn tōn akrōn
verses.literal: And He will send out His - angels with a loud trumpet call and they will gather His - elect from the four winds from one end of the heavens to - the [other]

verses.original: δὲ μάθετε τὴν παραβολήν Ἀπὸ τῆς συκῆς ὅταν ἤδη αὐτῆς ὁ κλάδος γένηται ἁπαλὸς καὶ ἐκφύῃ τὰ φύλλα γινώσκετε ὅτι τὸ θέρος ἐγγὺς
verses.transliteration: de mathete tēn parabolēn Apo tēs sykēs hotan ēdē autēs ho klados genētai hapalos kai ekphyē ta phylla ginōskete hoti to theros engys
verses.literal: Now learn this lesson from the fig tree As soon as . . . its - branches become tender and sprout - leaves you know that - summer [is] near

verses.original: οὕτως καὶ ὅταν ἴδητε πάντα ταῦτα ὑμεῖς γινώσκετε ὅτι ἐστιν ἐγγύς ἐπὶ θύραις
verses.transliteration: houtōs kai hotan idēte panta tauta hymeis ginōskete hoti estin engys epi thyrais
verses.literal: So also when you see all these things you will know that He is near right at [the] door

verses.original: ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν ὅτι αὕτη ἡ γενεὰ οὐ μὴ παρέλθῃ ἕως ἂν πάντα ταῦτα γένηται
verses.transliteration: amēn legō hymin hoti hautē hē genea ou mē parelthē heōs an panta tauta genētai
verses.literal: Truly I tell you - this - generation {will} not . . . pass away until . . . all these things have happened

verses.original: ὁ οὐρανὸς καὶ ἡ γῆ παρελεύσεται δὲ μου οἱ λόγοι οὐ μὴ παρέλθωσιν
verses.transliteration: ho ouranos kai hē gē pareleusetai de mou hoi logoi ou mē parelthōsin
verses.literal: - Heaven and - earth will pass away but My - words {will} never . . . pass away

verses.original: δὲ οὐδεὶς οἶδεν Περὶ ἐκείνης τῆς ἡμέρας καὶ ὥρας οὐδὲ οἱ ἄγγελοι τῶν οὐρανῶν οὐδὲ ὁ Υἱός εἰ μὴ μόνος ὁ Πατὴρ
verses.transliteration: de oudeis oiden Peri ekeinēs tēs hēmeras kai hōras oude hoi angeloi tōn ouranōn oude ho Huios ei mē monos ho Patēr
verses.literal: - No one knows about that - day [or] hour not even the angels - in heaven nor the Son but . . . only the Father

verses.original: γὰρ ὥσπερ αἱ ἡμέραι τοῦ Νῶε οὕτως ἔσται ἡ παρουσία τοῦ Υἱοῦ τοῦ ἀνθρώπου
verses.transliteration: gar hōsper hai hēmerai tou Nōe houtōs estai hē parousia tou Huiou tou anthrōpou
verses.literal: - As [it was] in the days of Noah so will it be at the coming of the Son - of Man

verses.original: γὰρ ὡς ἐν ἐκείναις ταῖς ἡμέραις πρὸ ταῖς τοῦ κατακλυσμοῦ ἦσαν τρώγοντες καὶ πίνοντες γαμοῦντες καὶ γαμίζοντες ἄχρι ἧς ἡμέρας Νῶε εἰσῆλθεν εἰς τὴν κιβωτόν
verses.transliteration: gar hōs en ekeinais tais hēmerais pro tais tou kataklysmou ēsan trōgontes kai pinontes gamountes kai gamizontes achri hēs hēmeras Nōe eisēlthen eis tēn kibōton
verses.literal: For - in - the days before - the flood [people] were eating and drinking marrying and giving in marriage up to the day Noah entered . . . the ark

verses.original: καὶ οὐκ ἔγνωσαν ἕως ὁ κατακλυσμὸς ἦλθεν καὶ ἦρεν ἅπαντας καὶ οὕτως ἔσται ἡ παρουσία τοῦ Υἱοῦ τοῦ ἀνθρώπου
verses.transliteration: kai ouk egnōsan heōs ho kataklysmos ēlthen kai ēren hapantas kai houtōs estai hē parousia tou Huiou tou anthrōpou
verses.literal: And vvv they were oblivious until the flood came and swept them all away . . . - So will it be [at] the coming of the Son - of Man

verses.original: τότε δύο ἔσονται ἐν τῷ ἀγρῷ εἷς παραλαμβάνεται καὶ εἷς ἀφίεται
verses.transliteration: tote dyo esontai en tō agrō heis paralambanetai kai heis aphietai
verses.literal: - Two [men] will be in the field one will be taken and [the other] left

verses.original: δύο ἀλήθουσαι ἐν τῷ μύλῳ μία παραλαμβάνεται καὶ μία ἀφίεται
verses.transliteration: dyo alēthousai en tō mylō mia paralambanetai kai mia aphietai
verses.literal: Two [women] will be grinding at the mill one will be taken and [the other] left

verses.original: οὖν Γρηγορεῖτε ὅτι οὐκ οἴδατε ἡμέρᾳ ποίᾳ ὑμῶν ὁ κύριος ἔρχεται
verses.transliteration: oun Grēgoreite hoti ouk oidate hēmera poia hymōn ho kyrios erchetai
verses.literal: Therefore keep watch because vvv you do not know [the] day on which your - Lord will come

verses.original: δὲ γινώσκετε ἐκεῖνο ὅτι εἰ ὁ οἰκοδεσπότης ᾔδει ποίᾳ φυλακῇ ὁ κλέπτης ἔρχεται ἂν ἐγρηγόρησεν καὶ ἂν οὐκ εἴασεν αὐτοῦ τὴν οἰκίαν διορυχθῆναι
verses.transliteration: de ginōskete ekeino hoti ei ho oikodespotēs ēdei poia phylakē ho kleptēs erchetai an egrēgorēsen kai an ouk eiasen autou tēn oikian diorychthēnai
verses.literal: But understand this - If the homeowner had known in which watch of the night the thief was coming vvv he would have kept watch and vvv {would} not have let his - house be broken into

verses.original: διὰ τοῦτο ὑμεῖς καὶ γίνεσθε ἕτοιμοι ὅτι ὁ Υἱὸς τοῦ ἀνθρώπου ἔρχεται ᾗ ὥρᾳ οὐ δοκεῖτε
verses.transliteration: dia touto hymeis kai ginesthe hetoimoi hoti ho Huios tou anthrōpou erchetai hē hōra ou dokeite
verses.literal: For this reason . . . you also must be ready because the Son - of Man will come at an hour vvv you do not expect

verses.original: Τίς ἄρα ἐστὶν ὁ πιστὸς καὶ φρόνιμος δοῦλος ὃν ὁ κύριος κατέστησεν ἐπὶ αὐτοῦ τῆς οἰκετείας τοῦ δοῦναι αὐτοῖς τὴν τροφὴν ἐν καιρῷ
verses.transliteration: Tis ara estin ho pistos kai phronimos doulos hon ho kyrios katestēsen epi autou tēs oiketeias tou dounai autois tēn trophēn en kairō
verses.literal: Who then is the faithful and wise servant whom the master has put in charge of his - household - to give [the others] [their] food at the proper time

verses.original: μακάριος ἐκεῖνος ὁ δοῦλος ὃν αὐτοῦ ὁ κύριος εὑρήσει ποιοῦντα οὕτως ἐλθὼν
verses.transliteration: makarios ekeinos ho doulos hon autou ho kyrios heurēsei poiounta houtōs elthōn
verses.literal: Blessed [is] that - servant whose . . . - master finds him doing so when he returns

verses.original: ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν ὅτι καταστήσει αὐτόν ἐπὶ πᾶσιν αὐτοῦ τοῖς ὑπάρχουσιν
verses.transliteration: amēn legō hymin hoti katastēsei auton epi pasin autou tois hyparchousin
verses.literal: Truly I tell you - he will put him in charge . . . of all his - possessions

verses.original: δὲ Ἐὰν ἐκεῖνος ὁ δοῦλος κακὸς εἴπῃ ἐν αὐτοῦ τῇ καρδίᾳ μου ὁ κύριος Χρονίζει
verses.transliteration: de Ean ekeinos ho doulos kakos eipē en autou tē kardia mou ho kyrios Chronizei
verses.literal: But suppose that - servant [is] wicked [and] says in his - heart My - master will be away a long time

verses.original: καὶ ἄρξηται τύπτειν αὐτοῦ τοὺς συνδούλους δὲ ἐσθίῃ καὶ πίνῃ μετὰ τῶν μεθυόντων
verses.transliteration: kai arxētai typtein autou tous syndoulous de esthiē kai pinē meta tōn methyontōn
verses.literal: And he begins to beat his - fellow servants and to eat and drink with - drunkards

verses.original: ὁ κύριος ἐκείνου τοῦ δούλου ἥξει ἐν ἡμέρᾳ ᾗ οὐ προσδοκᾷ καὶ ἐν ὥρᾳ ᾗ οὐ γινώσκει
verses.transliteration: ho kyrios ekeinou tou doulou hēxei en hēmera hē ou prosdoka kai en hōra hē ou ginōskei
verses.literal: The master of that - servant will come on a day vvv vvv he does not expect and at an hour vvv vvv he does not anticipate

verses.original: καὶ διχοτομήσει αὐτὸν καὶ θήσει αὐτοῦ τὸ μέρος μετὰ τῶν ὑποκριτῶν ἐκεῖ ἔσται ὁ κλαυθμὸς καὶ ὁ βρυγμὸς τῶν ὀδόντων
verses.transliteration: kai dichotomēsei auton kai thēsei autou to meros meta tōn hypokritōn ekei estai ho klauthmos kai ho brygmos tōn odontōn
verses.literal: Then he will cut him to pieces . . . and assign him - a place with the hypocrites [where] there will be - weeping and - gnashing of teeth
